$comment: The only place model IDs live. Everything else uses the plain names. Prices are USD per million tokens on global profiles (estimates; the AWS bill is the truth).

knowledge.label: Amazon Titan Text Embeddings V2
knowledge.$comment: Owner's exception to Anthropic-only (2026-11-07): Anthropic has no embedding model. Called in-Region (eu-north-1) by the Bedrock knowledge base only.

files.label: Amazon Titan Text Embeddings V2
files.$comment: Files (decision 147): the same Titan V2, in-Region, called directly (InvokeModel) by the files Lambda, the api and the runtimes to embed each file's description and each search. 512 dimensions keep one vector at 1 KB on the file record. It never reasons or writes text.

executive.$comment: The Executive Leadership layer (decision 140): CEO, COO, CFO and CTO, advisory only. Stateless calls from AIC's and the Orchestrator's runtimes and the executives Lambda, with their own application inference profile.

departmentModels.$comment: The owner's rules (2026-11-09, decision 129): Claude Fable 5.1 for the Orchestrator and every Department Manager (roles above), and for the workers of the Media, Research and Legal departments (here); the Chief of Staff is on Fable too; every other worker uses Opus 5.5. Department names as in config/departments.json. A department the owner builds on demand carries its own worker_model on its ledger record (opus-5-5 unless the owner explicitly asks for fable-5-1, decision 134), which wins for its workers.

voice.$comment: Owner's exception to Anthropic-only (2026-11-08, decision 120): Amazon Nova 2.5 Sonic (then Nova 2 Sonic) is AIC's real-time voice (speech in, speech out, turn-taking, barge-in). voiceId tiffany: the warm American feminine voice closest to ChatGPT's Sol (Nova Sonic has no custom or cloned voices). It is only the voice: every request goes to AIC (Haiku) through the ask_aic tool. Tried in this order until one opens (regions vary by account); the first is the default.

cues.$comment: Thinking cues: said only when AIC has not answered after afterMs, then every againMs, at most max, and never while the owner is talking.

live.$comment: The owner's choice (2026-11-09, decision 128): OpenAI GPT-Live is AIC's first real-time voice, the most natural one offered (full duplex: it listens while it speaks). Client delegation: every request goes to AIC through the HUD's normal chat; GPT-Live only listens and speaks. Billed by OpenAI per minute on the owner's key (aic/prod/openai). voice: null = GPT-Live's default; set one of its voice names to change it. When it can't open, Nova Sonic (speech above) takes over.
